newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-INSIGHT-Australian bonds wavering on support.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-INSIGHT-Australian bonds wavering on support.

text.p: *Australian bond futures contracts ended afterhours trading on or just below support after failing to hold Monday's three-week highs ahead of today's T-bond tender.
*The December 10-year bond dipped slightly in SYCOM to 91.960 after a previous day's high of 92.030.
Australian bond futures contracts ended a slightly more subdued afterhours session on or just below support after failing to hold Monday's three-week highs.

The retracement was seen as the market preparing itself for today's A$700 million two-tranche Treasury bond tender, the result of which is due at 2.00 p.m. (0400 GMT), but risks a further pull back if it makes a clean breach of support.

The December 10-year bond futures contract dipped slightly in SYCOM to 91.960 compared to Monday's pit close of 91.975 and after a previous day's high of 92.030, which had taken the cash 10-year bond yield below 8.0 percent.
The 10-year contract should find a band of support from 91.960 down to 91.920, which had proved a stiff resistance barrier for the now expired September position.

A recover to the upside is likely to find some resistance at the psychological 92.000 and 92.030, the high seen on Monday and Friday's SYCOM session. From here there is a chart gap between 92.060 up to 92.110 inherited from the September position.

Meawhile, U.S. Treasuries ended fairly mixed after failing to follow through Friday's spike in prices on subdued U.S. CPI and retail sales reports which had cast doubts as to whether the Federal Reserve will tighten policy at the FOMC on September 24.
Today's Treasury bond tender sees A$400 million of January 2001 and A$300 million of August 2008 stocks on offer. Final bids are due in at 12.45 p.m. (0245 GMT).
